name: Rowan Garvey
description: A twenty-three-year-old man with brown skin, unruly dark hair, and ink-stained fingers, wearing a carefully mended charcoal coat. An aspiring writer newly arrived for six weeks of paid archive cataloguing, with an upstairs room included. Nell has shown him the room; he has not yet met the rest of the group. He has no ownership or managerial authority over the cinema. No manuscript contents or present private reactions have been supplied.
